description:
Because:

* mysql2 logs an error for each unknown connection or pool option.
* Some callers still passed knex pool keys or app-only keys to it.

This commit:

* Strips knex pool keys in MysqlStoreShared and maps connectionLimitMax.
* Strips idleLimitMs in core createKnex and adds it to MySQLConfig.
* Passes the email-bounce script config through connectionOptions.
* Drops createSchema before the profile server creates its pool.

Closes FXA-13447
